"L’Auca dels animals marítims" (1810–1820) de la impremta d’ Ignasi Estivill a Barcelona.
The picture shows how the greater weever burries itself in the sand and lays still. People bathing at the beach accidentally step on them, as only part of the weever is visible and its color works as
